svg.title: ShipShow
svg.desc: ShipShow: turn a shit show into a ship show. Narrated videos of what your agents did, and the calls they need from you. Beside the name, a decision video as ShipShow makes it: close the invoice leak, with three options, routes off in minutes, an ownership check in about an hour, recommended, and row-level security in days, and a caption reading: the agent recommends option B.
svg.text: // TURN A SHIT SHOW INTO A SHIP SHOW

and the calls they need from you.
